cues: The is used when the listener can tell exactly which one you mean.
Something mentioned before: I bought a shawl; the shawl was pashmina.
Unique things: the sun, the moon.
Superlatives and ordinals: the best answer, the first bench.
Rivers, mountain ranges and seas: the Koshi, the Himalayas.
Plural country names and organisations: the Netherlands, the U N. Newspapers, holy books and historical periods.
An adjective used as a noun: the poor.
And with only, same and whole.
